Source: http://www.kubby.com

Posted June 21, 2000
(MarijuanaNews note: On the 420 MarijuanaNews on Pot-TV.net today, long-time medical marijuana activist and cancer survivor, Steve Kubby announced that he would seek the Libertarian Vice-presidential nomination at the Party’s Anaheim convention on July 2nd.

Kubby asked me to make one of the nominating speeches for him, which I happily agreed to do. I am confident that his bid for the nomination will be successful, and he will be a very effective candidate, even though his use of medical marijuana to control a rare form of cancer means that he will be unable to campaign outside of California.

Now think about that. A Vice Presidential candidate cannot leave his home state because he would be arrested for using the medicine that keeps him alive!

Of course, that is why he is running.)

KUBBY FOR VICE PRESIDENT
Libertarian Party

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
June 21, 2000

Contact: Doug Scribner, Media Relations Secretary
Telephone: 949 / 515-8101
Email: doug@123abc.net
URL: http://www.kubby.com

HIGH-PROFILE LIBERTARIAN ACTIVIST ANNOUNCES FOR VICE PRESIDENTIAL NOMINATION

ORANGE COUNTY, CA -- Steve Kubby, a long-time Libertarian activist and National Director of the American Medical Marijuana Association, announced his campaign today for the Libertarian Party nomination for the office of Vice President of the United States.

" The death of my good friend, Peter McWilliams, last week galvanized my wife, Michele, and me into political action. We are determined to force a debate about the failed police 'War on Drugs' onto center stage in the November election. "
See
The Murder of Peter McWilliams -- An Indictment, Not an Obituary – by Richard Cowan

Kubby said that as a candidate of America's largest 'second party,' he will be able to hammer the " Demopublicans " on all the harm and misery their failed policies are creating. " We are going to make the most of this opportunity to educate Americans in our campaign for Vice President of the United States. "

Kubby ran as the Libertarian Party candidate for governor of California in 1998 and has been active in the libertarian movement for 20 years. He played a key role in the passage of California’s ballot Proposition 215 in 1996. California voters legalized the use of marijuana for medical therapy by a solid 55% majority in a historic popular vote. Subsequently, 7 other States have followed California's lead.

Kubby announced today, " I am deeply honored that a respected spokesman for our movement, Richard Cowan, who has served with distinction for over two decades in the cause of freedom, will make the nominating speech on my behalf. Cowan is the former Executive Director of NORML, and is now editor of MarijuanaNews.com, and anchor for the 420 MarijuanaNews on Pot-TV.net, a new Internet multi-media site devoted to cannabis.

" Peter McWilliams was a brilliant author and American patriot who was killed for his political beliefs -- by an overdose of government. " The VP candidate continued, " McWilliams' books inspired people to believe in and fight for their rights. Those responsible for the death of Peter have only added fuel to the fire. " Kubby proclaimed, " They killed the messenger, but the very message they tried to smother will burn more brilliantly than ever. "
See
Buckley Writes On McWilliams And Kubby Cases; Great Ending, If I May Say So.

He is a medical marijuana patient, under treatment for adrenal cancer.
See
Prominent Medical Specialist Says Steve Kubby Should Be Studied, Not Jailed;
His Case Has Major Medical Implications.

The Kubbys have deliberately created a test case for California's medical marijuana law and are presently defendants in Placer County, California for growing their own medicine as provided state law. " This is going to be the Scopes Monkey Trial for medical marijuana, with mainstream media coverage, " Kubby said.
See
The Kubbys and The Prosecutor – An Insight into Pathological Prosecution

Senior editor for the Orange County Register, Alan Bock, has been quoted as saying he has never seen as much pre-trial publicity as in the Kubby case.
See
Alan Bock Gives An Excellent Overview Of The Prospects For Medical Marijuana
and
California Libertarian Party And Orange County Register Assail Prosecution of The Kubbys

Kubby, 53, and his wife, Michele, are parents of two children and reside in Laguna Beach, California. He is also very close to his 24-year-old son, Sky, from an earlier marriage.

The Libertarian Party's National Convention will be held in Anaheim, California, June 29 through July 3.
